Author: Rayla Petal
Name: WatchAlong
Description:
Puts a Kosmi room on a screen inside FFXIV, joining as a real Kosmi guest via a
sandboxed out-of-process browser, so playback stays perfectly synced with the rest of the room.

Commands:
/wa - toggle the main viewer/control window
/wa view - open the main window
/wa join <kosmi url or WA1: invite> - join a room, or accept an invite (with confirmation)
/wa settings - open Settings (identity, volume/mute, join/leave, invite, screen placement)
/wa invite - copy a shareable invite for your current room and screen
/wa sync <WA1P: message> - apply a shared screen position (with confirmation)
/wa place - open the screen placement window
/wa focus - snap the camera to a fullscreen view of your placed screen (move to exit)
/wa forgetvenues - forget every remembered watch-along room (stops auto-rejoining any of them)
/wa vol <0-150> - set volume
/wa mute - toggle mute
/wa snapshot - save a debug screenshot + DOM outline
Punchline: Watch a Kosmi room together, in-game.

Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog:
- Bone Align: Match facing now snaps to the facing a couple animation was made for (same way as your partner, or facing them) instead of guessing from which way the body parts point, so animations like 306 Kittylingus line up straight even if you started slightly off. The status line says which facing it picked.
- Animations not made to be played on the same spot still use the previous part-direction turn and 180 degree check.

Author: Rayla Petal
Name: Oathbound
Description: A consent-based collar control plugin. Gameplay commands use ordinary in-game tells; relay-assisted pairing and encrypted catalog synchronization use the Oathbound Cloudflare service, while gameplay actions remain local to the Sub's client.
Punchline: Consent-based Owner/Sub control: outfit, title, gesture, and leash.
